acquisition_manifest.principle: Restrict only a proven unrepresentable state or a forced non-roster grant under the unchanged build08 rules, applied to the identity the screen itself displays. No hidden map/event outcome is inspected; residual unavoidable states end the run as an explicit unsupported outcome.

card_rule.rule: a displayed card outside frozen E's exact 214-card identity set (crl.vocab/v3-three-act-214) is never taken: card reward, shop, grid, bundle, special reward
card_rule.alternative: the screen's genuine skip/other options; shared/colorless generators are NOT banned (E's opt_admissible mask declines off-roster GeneratedCardToHand offers inside combat)

forced_named_grants.rule: an event option that unconditionally adds a named card outside the roster is declined (worker EventOptions.Grants table, resolved with RunNonCombatEffects.NamedCard)

declined_ancient_relics.reason: two card rewards drawn only from other characters' pools
Orobas option: a grid of another character's cards

declined_event_options.reason: KEEP THE KEY leads only to the Mysterious Knight fight (encounter 58); enemy id 110 is outside E's enemy vocabulary (crl/vocab.py BUILD08_ENEMIES_OUTSIDE_VOCAB)

acquisition_manifest.capacity_rule: a displayed relic acquisition is declined when MaxPotionSlots + its slots would exceed the six-slot representation (crl.potion_v1.inventory refuses capacity beyond the slot array)

potion_rule.rule: acquiring a potion with no modelled in-combat effect (crl.potion_v1.UNMODELLED_COMBAT_POTIONS minus the Automatic Fairy in a Bottle) is declined; automatic Fairy stays supported
potion_rule.source: crl/potion_v1.py UNMODELLED_COMBAT_POTIONS; PotionAdapter raises on a manual use of one

compatible_continuations.rule: no initial leave exists (decompiled ColorfulPhilosophers.cs); open the first displayed pool, whose three card rewards are skippable, and decline the foreign cards. Zero reward, recorded as a deterministic continuation.

loop_suppressions: a card-reward row declined (skip) is not offered again until the run's public persistent state changes
a potion-row claim on a full belt without Sozu is a no-op and is not offered
the smith screen's cancel is never offered: smith is one committed choice (open + upgrade one card)
bundle highlight + confirm is one committed choice
the generic event skip (engine action 3) is offered only where the game displays it (Wongos LEAVE; Self-Help Book NO_OPTIONS)

neows_bones_dead_end_relics.rule: while Neow's Bones' TWO rows are still on the reward screen (PendingNeowsBonesCurse), a row whose relic pickup opens a card grid or deck selection is declined: RunRewardGenerator.ClaimRewardAtIndex promotes the other row (OfferNextBonusRelic) and the grid/selection's completion returns straight to Neow (RunEngine.CloseOfferGrid / StepTransformSelect with NeowAwaitingProceed); the promoted row is abandoned on map travel and PendingNeowsBonesCurse stays set, so every later reward screen has no legal action (WriteActionMask withholds leave). Claimed LAST, OfferNextBonusRelic settles the curse (AddNeowsBonesCurse) before the screen opens and the pickup is safe, so the genuine alternative is to claim the other row first. If both rows are such relics the run is an explicit unsupported state. Deterministic from the displayed identities.
neows_bones_dead_end_relics.evidence: engine: phase=RelicReward neows_bones_curse_pending=True has_pending_rewards=False mask [] (diagnostic runs m0/m82, 2026-10-05)
neows_bones_dead_end_relics.engine_repair_note: a genuine unchanged-engine semantic defect; no engine edit is made. A scoped repair (return the grid/selection to the Bones reward screen) would remove the need for this restriction.

MANGLE_POWER.semantics: Enemy Debuff Counter: separate Strength is reduced by Amount; the positive counter restores Amount Strength at owner side turn end

SETUP_STRIKE_POWER.semantics: Positive Counter origin: Strength is granted separately; removes this power and applies -Amount Strength at owner side turn end

SPEED_POTION_POWER.semantics: Positive Counter origin: Dexterity is granted separately; removes this power and applies -Amount Dexterity at owner side turn end

FLEX_POTION_POWER.semantics: Positive Counter origin: Strength is granted separately; removes this power and applies -Amount Strength at owner side turn end

CRIMSON_MANTLE_POWER.semantics: AfterPlayerTurnStart gains Amount block; self damage is a separate helper row

ENERGY_NEXT_TURN_POWER.semantics: AfterEnergyReset gains Amount energy once and removes the power

DRAW_CARDS_NEXT_TURN_POWER.semantics: Adds Amount to the next owner hand draw and removes after side turn starts

SELF_FORMING_CLAY_POWER.semantics: Buff Counter applied by the Self-Forming Clay relic on unblocked damage; AfterBlockCleared gains Amount unpowered block once and removes the power, identical to BlockNextTurnPower; separate native origins stack in one frozen counter

AMBERGRIS_POWER.semantics: Hidden Buff Counter applied at 1 by in-combat Ambergris; ShouldTakeExtraTurn while Amount>0 and AfterTakingExtraTurn decrements it, whichever source granted the turn. The extra turn itself is public only through turn/round_number (frozen extra_turns_taken/in_extra_turn): native SwitchSides raises the turn number without RoundNumber, like frozen TakeExtraTurn
